description: Ask a new question over a completed search's corpus and get a cited answer, without searching again. Costs less than a new search: only the answer is metered at the API rate. Good for 'what do they say about price', 'summarize the objections', 'which phrases do they use for the problem'. Works on searches started through the API or MCP.

search_id.description: The search id returned by `search` or `list_searches`.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait server-side for completion before returning (0 to 55). Call again to resume.

name: ask
title: Ask a follow-up
